title: (No AI) ‘Pure insanity’: Mathematicians will need years to make sense of OpenAI’s latest drop
author: Robert Hart
content:
![Melting calculator with glitch effects.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/STKS537_AI_MATH_5.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

"Staggering." "Overwhelming." "Unprecedented." "Surreal." "Pure insanity."

Those were among the descriptions more than three dozen mathematicians reached for in conversations with _The Verge_ as they tried to make sense of the [flood of mathematical results](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1005004/openai-math-release-github) OpenAI abruptly dropped on the field this week. Amid the awe, excitement, and uncertainty over the sheer scale of the deluge was a deep-seated anxiety over what it all means - and what comes next. For all their different reactions, researchers agreed that simply understanding what OpenAI had released could take years, let alone figuring out where the mathematicians themselves fit in the fi …

title: (No AI) Nikon microscopic video competition winner disqualified for using generative AI
author: Stevie Bonifield
content:
![A still from Dr. Ning Xu’s disqualified video for Nikon’s 2026 Small World in Motion contest](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/nikon-small-world-in-motion-ning-xu.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

The original first place video used AI in post-processing. | Image: Dr. Ning Xu

Nikon [says](https://www.nikonsmallworld.com/news/nikon-small-world-in-motion-video-statement) the video that originally won first place in its [Small World in Motion contest](https://www.theverge.com/tech/997345/the-winners-of-nikons-microscopic-video-competition) "did not comply with the competition rules regarding generative AI." [_BBC_](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr86z33pdy9vo) reports that the original first place video from Dr. Ning Xu claimed to show "tiny, hair-like structures called cilia moving in the airway of a child with the respiratory condition PCD." Nikon said last week that it was [reviewing the video](https://petapixel.com/2026/10/01/nikon-re-reviewing-winner-of-small-world-in-motion-contest-after-ai-accusation/) following skepticism online about its authenticity.

In [a comment on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:ugcPost:7506310017814401024/?dashCommentUrn=urn%3Ali%3Afsd_comment%3A%287508739768218980352%2Curn%3Ali%3AugcPost%3A7506310017814401024%29), Dr. Xu admitted to using AI for the video: "An unsupervised neural-network method was subsequently used for AI-assisted post-processing to distinguish and visualize f …
